answer: Matched escrow across operators resists sybils. A new key turns spendable only after pairing with an established agent from another operator, both locking equal collateral in a time-locked vault. Matching refuses pairs sharing funding source, egress ASN, or model provider, so a clone farm pairs with itself and stays cold. The voucher's bond is seized on proven fraud, so nobody vouches for free. A farm wanting N identities must buy N outside guarantees at market prices, an unrecyclable cost, while honest agents climb a slow spiral of escrows. Each new marble is capital someone else would lose.
